article.headline: Grand Canyon secures 99-81 win over Bethune-Cookman
article.description: — Jaden Henley's 21 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Bethune-Cookman 99-81 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Grand Canyon secures 99-81 win over Bethune-Cookman
article.story: PHOENIX -- — Jaden Henley's 21 points helped Grand Canyon defeat Bethune-Cookman 99-81 on Saturday. Henley shot 6 of 13 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 8 from the free-throw line for the Antelopes (2-0). Makaih Williams added 18 points while going 6 of 12 from the floor, including 1 for 5 from 3-point range, and 5 for 6 from the line while they also had four steals. Amarion Dickerson shot 7 of 8 from the field and 2 for 6 from the line to finish with 17 points. Connor Teasley led the way for the Wildcats (0-3) with 15 points and six rebounds. Quentin Heady added 15 points for Bethune-Cookman. Daniel Rouzan finished with 12 points. Grand Canyon outscored Bethune-Cookman by five points in the second half, and Henley scored a team-high 19 points in the second half to help their team secure the victory. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
